boards.title: Your First Weekend at United States Merchant Marine Academy, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative, on-campus first-weekend sequence for getting oriented to Kings Point’s waterfront, services, study spaces, and shared landmarks.

cards.title: Start at Vickery Gate
cards.subtitle: Arrival point at the USMMA campus
cards.notes: Begin by confirming the Academy’s current operating status and entry instructions, then pick up a campus map at the security gate for your first walk.
cards.short_summary: Use the campus entry point to orient yourself before exploring.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA directs self-guided visitors to check operating status and says a campus map is available at the security gate; its campus map identifies Vickery Gate.
cards.access_notes: Follow current gate, identification, and operating-status instructions before entering.

cards.title: Spot Wiley Hall from the waterfront side
cards.subtitle: Historic administration building facing Long Island Sound
cards.notes: Use the exterior as a landmark on your first loop. Save any office business for official hours and follow posted building-access guidance.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable historic anchor for the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA identifies Wiley Hall as its chief administration center and says it faces Long Island Sound; the campus map lists Wiley Hall.
cards.access_notes: Administrative offices and interior access may be restricted; view from permitted campus areas.

cards.title: Find Bland Library before you need it
cards.subtitle: Campus library near the academic core
cards.notes: Locate the entrance and bookmark the library’s help options. If you are visiting rather than enrolled, contact the library ahead to arrange an appointment.
cards.short_summary: Get your bearings in the Academy’s research and reading hub.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA says its library provides information resources and services at Kings Point, and asks visitors to contact the library in advance to schedule a visit.
cards.access_notes: Visitors should contact the library in advance at the number listed by USMMA to schedule an appointment.

cards.title: Mark Bowditch Hall on your route
cards.subtitle: Marine Transportation and Ackerman Auditorium building
cards.notes: Walk past Bowditch Hall while learning the central-campus paths. Note the auditorium location so future Academy lectures or ceremonies are easier to find.
cards.short_summary: A practical landmark for navigating the academic center.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA states that Bowditch Hall houses the Department of Marine Transportation and the 900-seat Ackerman Auditorium.
cards.access_notes: Use public or authorized routes; event and building access vary.

cards.title: Locate Delano Hall and Topside Dining Room
cards.subtitle: Midshipman dining location on the central campus
cards.notes: Add the dining hall to your mental map and check official Academy instructions for meal access. Keep this stop simple: learn the route before a busy weekday.
cards.short_summary: Know where the dining area sits in relation to the residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA identifies Delano Hall as the midshipman dining room, and its campus map lists both Delano Hall and the Topside Dining Room.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and meal arrangements are Academy-controlled; verify current eligibility and service details.

cards.title: Check out Land Hall’s activity spaces
cards.subtitle: Midshipmen Activities Center
cards.notes: Find the Office of Student Activities and ask about registered organizations or reservable spaces. Choose a daytime visit rather than assuming an event is open.
cards.short_summary: A starting point for learning how student activities are organized.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA calls Land Hall the center of midshipman downtime and says it contains club and meeting rooms, with reserved space available for registered student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Reserved space is for registered student organizations; contact the Office of Student Activities for availability.

cards.title: Pin O’Hara Hall for recreation
cards.subtitle: Indoor athletic facility
cards.notes: Locate O’Hara Hall and review current athletics or recreation guidance before using any facility. Treat it as a route-planning stop, not a promise of drop-in access.
cards.short_summary: Identify the main indoor athletics landmark early.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA describes O’Hara Hall as an indoor facility with a gymnasium, Olympic-size swimming pool and diving well, racquetball courts, and training areas.
cards.access_notes: Facility use, team activity, and recreation access are subject to Academy rules and schedules.

cards.title: Walk to Yocum Sailing Center
cards.subtitle: Waterfront facility on Hague Basin
cards.notes: Take in the waterfront setting from authorized areas and note the sailing center’s location. Ask waterfront staff before entering team or operations spaces.
cards.short_summary: See where the Academy’s waterfront activity is based.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA describes Yocum Sailing Center as a waterfront facility along Long Island Sound with direct access to Hague Basin.
cards.access_notes: Waterfront and team spaces are operational areas; observe barriers and obtain permission before entry.

cards.title: Pause at Mariners’ Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: National memorial chapel overlooking Long Island Sound
cards.notes: Visit respectfully from permitted areas and check the chapel’s weekly schedule if you want to attend a voluntary service or event during the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A reflective campus landmark with an active spiritual-life program.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA says Mariners’ Memorial Chapel is a National Memorial honoring merchant mariners who died at sea in the World Wars, and its spiritual-life programs include weekly Sunday services.
cards.access_notes: Respect services and memorial use; the chapel contact page lists office hours as Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m. ET.

cards.title: End with the American Merchant Marine Museum
cards.subtitle: Museum on USMMA’s McNulty Campus
cards.notes: Call ahead to confirm visitor arrangements, then use the exhibits to connect the Academy’s waterfront setting with maritime history and the institution’s heritage.
cards.short_summary: Close the orientation loop with the Academy’s maritime-history museum.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA states that the American Merchant Marine Museum is located on the McNulty Campus and documents that it opened in 1979 to exhibit the Academy’s heritage assets.
cards.source_title: American Merchant Marine Museum History & Timeline
cards.access_notes: USMMA’s visitor page provides a museum contact number; call to confirm access before going.
